title: Tall white in an Orcas pub asks what it's like to live on Earth
plain: In a pub on Orcas Island, a stranger of the kind UFO lore calls a "tall white", meaning a tall, pale, human-looking being, asked a local what it is like to live there, and when the answer was about the island, said, "No, on Earth." Brent Friedman tells Michels he heard this from a friend on Orcas Island, whom he does not name. If true, it would mean a visitor not from Earth was sitting in an ordinary bar making small talk.
